title: Kool-Aid Man OH YEAH
blurb: OH YEAAAAH! — the Kool-Aid Man, arriving through a load-bearing wall as always. He has never once used a door and shows no interest in learning. Play it for unexpected entrances, uninvited opinions, and anyone who joins a conversation with maximum property damage. Structurally irresponsible, spiritually correct.
origin: The Kool-Aid Man's iconic wall-smashing catchphrase.
